reviews.text: It was bleeding from the bird's pin feathers. It was an early night visit, but they were able to treat it immediately. It has recovered completely.

My dog ​​fell off the sofa in the middle of the night and was lethargic and clearly unwell, unable to put his front paws on the ground, so I brought him in for a checkup.

They responded quickly, the explanations during the examination were easy to understand, and they even sent the medical report via LINE, which made the handover to my regular vet very smooth. It was a great help.

I will definitely come back here if anything else happens.

We received care for our one-year-old Chihuahua when he had a fever.

After calling ahead, we were seen immediately without any waiting time.

It was our first time using an emergency veterinary hospital, and we were anxious, but the veterinarian was very kind and thorough, explaining all the necessary tests and costs as we went along, which put our dog's mind at ease.

They also promptly sent us the necessary paperwork for our regular vet via LINE, which we greatly appreciated.

If anything happens to our dog at night in the future, we would definitely want to use this hospital again.

Dear Maki Kawase,
Thank you very much for your kind and high rating.
As an animal hospital in Minato Ward, Tokyo, we strive to provide compassionate care that is attentive to the feelings of families, even during times of sudden health changes.
The Staff of Shiba Animal Clinic, Minato Ward Animal Emergency Medical Center

I've always enjoyed seeing this doctor's posts on TikTok, and I've always found their content interesting. I've always thought I'd like to rely on them if something ever came up.

This time, I used their services for my cat. She doesn't usually show much interest in human food, so I let my guard down, and before I knew it, she'd licked some grapes I'd given to my child.

After researching, I panicked because of the risk of acute renal failure and the fact that it was nighttime. There weren't any clinics nearby that offered nighttime care, so I was at a loss, but this clinic immediately came to mind. This clinic responded quickly and courteously to my inquiry. The nighttime consultation fee was cheaper than my local clinic, and I was able to use my pet insurance, which was great.

The treatment was thorough, and I felt completely at ease leaving my cat in their care. My regular vet said my cat gets very agitated if anything is done to her, so I think I caused some trouble, but I'm glad they were able to give her such a thorough examination.

Fortunately, everything turned out fine, and she's been healthy ever since.

I would like to consult with you again if anything comes up.

Thank you very much for everything.

My bearded dragon's leg was swollen, so I took it to the vet overnight.

An X-ray revealed a bone tumor.

Following the vet's advice, I immediately found a hospital that could provide specialized treatment, and the leg was amputated.

The procedure was successful, and today it was discharged and returned home.
The phone service was very poor and unpleasant.

The phone service was very polite.

The explanation of the procedure was easy to understand, and the prognosis is good.

My rabbit received emergency treatment.

The service was perfect.

It was almost 2 AM, and I had a hard time finding a veterinary hospital that could see my Richardson's ground squirrel, so I was relieved to be able to get an online consultation. Their courteous service was incredibly helpful. I would definitely use their services again if needed.
